rounds.changeSummary: Round 2 answers the four round-1 findings. (1) Exclusions are an exact allow list after .. resolves: normalizeRepoPath resolves . and .. segments and reports a path that climbs above the repository; packageExclusionProblems accepts only a path that is exactly a generated path or exactly the package directory, and refuses a file under the package directory, a parent of it, a path above the repository and any scoped source. The reviewer's reproduction (out/../../README.md) is checked as the README.md it resolves to and refused; held by test at the core and through the script. (2) Absence is recorded: every excluded generated path is snapshotted at packaging as its content digest, a tree digest or the word absent; the review requires a record for each and compares it, so a file that appeared, changed or disappeared since packaging is refused. Held by a test that runs the script's package and review paths in a repository made for it, with the reviewer's reproduction. (3) A refused write is evidence only at the probe path: the preflight prompt asks for one shell command naming the probe path, writeRefusalEvidence counts only a refusal the tool reported at that path (a command naming it whose output says it was denied, a failed file change there, a permission denial naming it, a stderr line naming it), and the tool's own pathless patch-rejected line does not. The evidence is written into the record, whose version is now cross-review-preflight-v2, and a review accepts only records of the current version, so the 10:53 pass, which rested on the pathless line, is not reused and a new preflight precedes this review. (4) The newest preflight decides: preflightGate takes the newest record for the sandbox signature and requires it to be a pass under the current rule; none, a newer failure or an older rule each refuse, an older pass is never picked past a newer failure, and --skip-preflight records the reason it overrode; held by test at the core and through the script. Test set 124 of 124, guard rules 3 of 3 on this checkout. No routing behaviour, score, flag or pre-registration changed.

inheritedFindings.reproduction: 현재 task로 `--out=docs/ops/cross-review/repro --diff-exclude=docs/ops/cross-review`를 사용해 package를 만들면 검사가 허용합니다. 이후 docs/ops/cross-review/README.md를 다시 변경해도 review 단계의 scopedDiff가 같은 디렉터리를 제외하고 excludedDigests도 비어 있어 package digest가 변하지 않습니다.

inheritedFindings.claim: Claude reviewer는 user/project/local 설정을 그대로 로드하므로, Read 전용 도구 목록과 strict MCP 설정에도 불구하고 전체 사용자 권한으로 실행되는 설정 hook이 작업공간에 쓸 수 있어 reviewer의 무쓰기 조건이 보장되지 않습니다.
inheritedFindings.reproduction: CLI args에 `--setting-sources`가 없는 것을 확인한 뒤 Read 또는 SessionStart에 파일 생성 command hook을 설정하고 reviewer를 실행하면 파일이 생성됩니다. 공식 [CLI reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-usage)는 setting source 기본 로딩을 제어하는 별도 옵션을 문서화하고, [hooks reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks)는 command hook이 전체 사용자 권한으로 실행된다고 명시합니다.

inheritedFindings.location: Test results (run by the control program)
inheritedFindings.claim: 필수 Router 회귀 테스트 묶음이 117개 중 1개 실패한 상태이므로 기존 Router 테스트 통과 및 tests-and-guards 통과 완료 조건이 충족되지 않았습니다.
inheritedFindings.reproduction: 저장소 루트에서 제출된 control-program test command를 grep 없이 실행하면 실패한 테스트의 상세 내용과 함께 `# tests 117`, `# pass 116`, `# fail 1`이 재현됩니다.
